_note: DEMO catalog of Dev B (F8). Every output is labelled DEMO. The action texts are demonstration texts; the citations name the rule source when there is one. One rule for each rule in the Monitoring catalog (rules/catalog/monitoring.json); tests/knowledge/test_rule_coverage.py cross-checks them.

passages.excerpt: Headache between 2.8 and 4.5 mmHg of ppCO₂; fatigue, poor sleep and nausea above 4.5 mmHg.
Hypoxia can cause mental changes that are sometimes imperceptible to the astronaut, reduced vision, fatigue, nausea, headache, dizziness and hyperventilation.
Space motion sickness lasts about 3 days on average.

rules.text: Pre-alert: ppCO₂ reaches or exceeds 2.5 mmHg (1 h average).

citations.excerpt: TB-004 (2.5 mmHg 7-day limit, used as a pre-alert)

rules.text: The 1-hour average ppCO₂ exceeds the 3 mmHg limit of the standard.

citations.excerpt: V2 6003 and Table 6.2-1 (band proposed by the team)

rules.text: PIO₂ is at or below 122 mmHg (1 h average).

citations.excerpt: V2 6003 and Table 6.2-1 (band proposed by the team)

rules.text: Pressure drops faster than the 13.5 psi/min limit.

check_ventilation_and_filters.title: Check ventilation and CO₂ filters
check_ventilation_and_filters.description: Check that the fans and the CO₂ filters work and are not saturated.

measure_co2_in_local_zones.title: Measure CO₂ in local zones
measure_co2_in_local_zones.description: Use a portable sensor in the zone where the value rises.

check_o2_supply_and_pressure.title: Check O₂ supply and pressure
check_o2_supply_and_pressure.description: Confirm the O₂ flow and the total cabin pressure.

reduce_physical_exertion.title: Reduce physical exertion
reduce_physical_exertion.description: Lower activity while oxygenation is verified.

verify_sensors_and_airtightness.title: Verify sensors and airtightness
verify_sensors_and_airtightness.description: Check that the pressure sensors read correctly and that there are no leaks.

check_pressure_in_other_zones.title: Check the pressure in other zones
check_pressure_in_other_zones.description: Compare the reading with sensors in other zones.

verify_hatch_and_seal_integrity.title: Verify hatches and seals
verify_hatch_and_seal_integrity.description: Inspect the hatches and seals of the affected zone.

isolate_zone.title: Isolate the zone
isolate_zone.description: Close off the affected zone until the cause is confirmed.

verify_atmosphere_composition.title: Verify the atmosphere composition
verify_atmosphere_composition.description: Check the diluent and O₂ percentages.

check_n2_sensor.title: Check the N₂ sensor
check_n2_sensor.description: Check the calibration of the diluent sensor.

check_condenser_and_ventilation.title: Check the condenser and ventilation
check_condenser_and_ventilation.description: Inspect the condenser and the airflow.

check_humidity_sensor.title: Check the humidity sensor
check_humidity_sensor.description: Verify the reading against a reference instrument.

check_thermal_loop_and_ventilation.title: Check the thermal loop and ventilation
check_thermal_loop_and_ventilation.description: Check the thermal loop and the airflow.

check_temperature_sensor.title: Check the temperature sensor
check_temperature_sensor.description: Verify the reading against a reference instrument.

check_zone_trend.title: Check the trend in the zone
check_zone_trend.description: Look at the zone chart before acting.

verify_airtightness_and_seals.title: Verify airtightness and seals
verify_airtightness_and_seals.description: Check that there are no leaks in the seals and hatches of the affected zone.

check_sensor_and_trend.title: Check the sensor and the trend
check_sensor_and_trend.description: Check that the sensor reads correctly and look at the zone chart before acting.
